name: ms parse accepts negative durations

source.note: Minimized from vercel/ms #70 / #96: parse regex did not accept a leading minus, so ms('-5') failed. Standalone parse(); format helpers omitted.

description: This duration parser is the vercel/ms parse() helper. Positive values such as 1h and .5ms already work. Negative inputs including -5, -.5ms and -0.5ms must return negative milliseconds. The seed regex does not allow a leading minus, so those strings fail to match and parse returns undefined. Update the capture so a leading '-' is accepted without breaking the existing positive cases.
